description: READ-ONLY. Maps WooCommerce products to the Amazon catalog of an outpost (account_id): same SKU in the Amazon catalog (data-hub), and with lookup_ean=true the EAN/GTIN searched in the Amazon catalog (max 20 EANs per call). Shows matched, unmatched, items without SKU or EAN. Changes nothing on either side.

lookup_ean.description: Also search unmatched EANs in the Amazon catalog (default false)

name: woo_amazon_mapping
